description: A utility class providing common functions for LoRa provider operations, including validation of gateway JSON objects, URL normalization, encoding conversions between hex and Base64, and helper methods for extracting LoRa configuration from gateway devices.

classes.name: LoraUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for validating, converting, and extracting LoRa gateway-related data.

methods.name: isValidLoraGateway
methods.description: Checks if the given JSON object represents a valid LoRa gateway configuration.

methods.name: getNormalizedProviderUrlFromGatewayDevice
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the provider URL from a gateway device JSON object, removing trailing slashes.

methods.name: convertFromHexToBase64
methods.description: Converts a hex-encoded string to its Base64 equivalent, throwing an exception for invalid input.

methods.name: convertFromBase64ToHex
methods.description: Converts a Base64-encoded string to its hex representation, throwing an exception for invalid input.

methods.name: convertToHexString
methods.description: Converts a byte array to its hex string representation.

methods.name: getLoraConfigFromLoraGatewayDevice
methods.description: Extracts the LoRa configuration JSON object from a gateway device JSON object.

methods.name: isHttpSuccessStatusCode
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code indicates success (2xx).

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks whether a string is null, empty, or consists solely of whitespace.
